# Fluent 2

`fluent2` is a LiNo theme with light, dark, high-contrast and reduced-motion
values. It uses Microsoft Fluent tokens as build-time data; it has no Fluent
runtime, bundled font or icon dependency. The applied font stack starts with
`system-ui, sans-serif`.

```js
import { loadTheme, fluentThemeFromBrand } from '@link-foundation/ui-themes';
import { loadThemes, resolveTheme } from '@link-foundation/ui-tokens/themes';
const fluent = await loadTheme('fluent2');
const { themes } = loadThemes(
  fluentThemeFromBrand('#0067c0', { id: 'my-brand' })
);
const registry = new Map([...fluent.chain, ...themes].map((t) => [t.id, t]));
const custom = resolveTheme(registry, 'my-brand');
```

Pass the resolved theme to `mountControls` or `mountDocument` through `themes`.
Set `theme fluent2` and `scheme light`, `dark` or `system` on a document or
subtree. `contrast more` selects high contrast; `contrast system` follows the
platform. The theme engine maps forced colors to Canvas, CanvasText, Highlight
and HighlightText, including CanvasText borders. `(forced-color token.path CanvasText)`
rows map namespaced aliases too, so brand foregrounds remain legible on system surfaces. Focusable parts have a visible
2px outline. User motion preferences retain priority.

The gallery at [`examples/themes/fluent2.html`](../../examples/themes/fluent2.html)
shows every in-scope control and all five button appearances. `primary` maps to
`variant filled`, `secondary` to `secondary`, `outline` to `outlined`, `subtle`
to `text` and `transparent` to `transparent`. State colors use Fluent aliases;
no opacity layer supplies hover, pressed or disabled colors.

`fluentBrandRamp(seed)` returns 16 stops, 10–160, by interpolating OKLCH lightness
and tapering chroma into sRGB gamut through ui-core's color helpers.
`fluentThemeFromBrand(rampOrSeed, { id })` returns nested LiNo extending fluent2.
The default web brand uses stop **80** for the light brand background and **70**
for dark, verified against this version's factories. Every brand-dependent alias
is generated by probing the factories with distinct colors. High contrast keeps
Microsoft's fixed values. Arbitrary custom brands are checked by the engine's
contrast adjustment when compiled; exact upstream reproduction is tested using
the default ramp.

## Reproduction and provenance

The generator consumes `@fluentui/tokens` **1.0.0-alpha.24**, an MIT licensed dev
dependency pinned in the lockfile. Its exports `webLightTheme`, `webDarkTheme`
and `teamsHighContrastTheme` supply all 459 light aliases and their mode values.
Every generated token retains `(fluent originalName)` and `(source-value value)`;
values such as rgba, shadows and curves are translated into typed LiNo. Original
font strings are retained as data; the applied `font.body` uses system fonts.
Source values are preserved for exact reconstruction, including numeric weights.

Generated color and shadow modes are split into separate files to respect the
1,500-line limit. `theme.lino` composes the fragments through normal inheritance.
The full token set is unchanged by contrast checking for the declared pairs:
text requires 4.5:1, accessible borders require `(min 3)`. Decorative strokes
and disabled colors are preserved, not incorrectly declared as text pairs.

Templates describe the controls' Open UI part anatomy. The native controls keep
their established keyboard and ARIA behavior; button consumes the template's
replaceable part tree. Other controls expose their existing native parts and
use the same scoped part style rules. Theme switching preserves those nodes.

```bash
node packages/ui-themes/scripts/generate-fluent2.mjs
node packages/ui-themes/scripts/fluent2-docs.mjs
node --test packages/ui-themes/tests/fluent2-*.test.js
npx playwright test tests/e2e/theme-fluent2.spec.js --project=chromium --workers=1
npm ls --omit=dev --workspace @link-foundation/ui-themes
```

Sources, reconciled with the [guidelines digest](../guidelines/README.md):

- [Fluent color roles and interaction states](https://fluent2.microsoft.design/color)
- [Fluent button appearances and contrast](https://fluent2.microsoft.design/components/web/react/core/button/usage)
- [Fluent token source](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui/tree/master/packages/tokens)
- [MIT notice](../../assets/fluent2/LICENSE.txt)

## React v9 migration mapping

These rows describe vocabulary correspondence, not automatic React conversion.
Partial mappings name the behavior needing application adaptation.

<!-- mapping:start -->

| Component    | Kind        | Props                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Status  | Notes                                                                                                |
| ------------ | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Button       | button      | appearance=primary → variant filled; appearance=secondary → variant secondary; appearance=outline → variant outlined; appearance=subtle → variant text; appearance=transparent → variant transparent; disabled=true → disabled true | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| ToggleButton | button      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | partial | The application owns checked state and toggle behavior; no automatic checked prop conversion.        |
| Input        | text-field  | value=\* → value \*; placeholder=\* → placeholder \*                                                                                                                                                                                | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Textarea     | text-area   | value=\* → value \*                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Checkbox     | checkbox    | checked=true → checked true; checked=mixed → checked mixed                                                                                                                                                                          | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| RadioGroup   | radio-group | value=\* → value \*; layout=horizontal → orientation horizontal                                                                                                                                                                     | mapped  | Use radio children with label/value.                                                                 |
| Switch       | switch      | checked=true → checked true                                                                                                                                                                                                         | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Slider       | slider      | value=\* → value \*; min=\* → min \*; max=\* → max \*; step=\* → step \*                                                                                                                                                            | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Dropdown     | select      | selectedOptions=\* → value \*                                                                                                                                                                                                       | partial | Single selection only.                                                                               |
| Combobox     | combobox    | value=\* → value \*                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | partial | Multiple selection requires application handling.                                                    |
| Dialog       | dialog      | open=true → open true                                                                                                                                                                                                               | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Menu         | menu        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Tooltip      | tooltip     | content=\* → label \*                                                                                                                                                                                                               | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Toast        | toast       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Drawer       | drawer      | open=true → open true                                                                                                                                                                                                               | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| TabList      | tabs        | selectedValue=\* → active \*                                                                                                                                                                                                        | mapped  | Map the selected value to the corresponding tab element ID.                                          |
| Card         | stack       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | partial | Use a stack for static cards; interactive card selection needs application behavior.                 |
| Avatar       | avatar      | name=\* → name \*                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | mapped  |                                                                                                      |
| Badge        | badge       | color=brand → tone primary                                                                                                                                                                                                          | partial | Fluent appearance palette is not automatically converted.                                            |
| Spinner      | progress    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | partial | Indeterminate progress uses the existing progress kind; circular spinner anatomy is not implemented. |

<!-- mapping:end -->
